name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Noise.slpBound_le_alevel
title: BGG+ noise bound of a NAND program is exponential only in its asymmetric level, polynomial in its depth
statement: For the homomorphic-evaluation noise bound slpBound (WN * bound(a) + bound(b) at a gate, E at inputs, 0 at the constant 1), every wire w satisfies slpBound <= (WN + 1)^L * (depth + 1)^(L + 1) * E, where the asymmetric level L is 0 at inputs and at 1 and max(L(a) + 1, L(b)) at a gate whose left (multiplied) operand is a. So only the number of multiplied edges on a path costs a factor WN; a program whose multiplied operands are always shallow (branching-program shape) has noise polynomial in its depth.
